svg.title: Tools carry the science: Rosetta and simulators, not chat
svg.desc: In Agent Rosetta and agentic epidemiological modeling, the LLM orchestrates while physics-based design software or a calibrated simulator supplies the scientific constraint.

text.tspan: Tools carry the science: Rosetta and simulators, not chat
In Agent Rosetta and agentic epidemiological modeling, the LLM orchestrates while physics-based design
software or a calibrated simulator supplies the scientific constraint.
LLM plans; the domain tool evaluates
Agents synthesize, calibrate, and refine simulators
Tool use is not experimental validation
